newsitem.title: GERMANY: Electrolux German unit to cut 1,500 jobs.
newsitem.headline: Electrolux German unit to cut 1,500 jobs.

text.p: AEG Hausgeraete GmbH, a home appliance unit of Sweden's A.B. Electrolux, said on Tuesday it planned to eliminate 1,500 of 8,500 jobs worldwide as a result of stiff price competition.
One third of the affected jobs would be cut through outsourcing, one third through layoffs and another third through attrition, the company said.
The remaining 7,000 employees would have guaranteed jobs until 2001, the company said.

In Stockholm on Tuesday, Electrolux said the European market for washers and other "white goods" fell three percent in the first quarter of 1997. Its first-quarter pretax profit fell 14 percent to 694 million crowns, as sales rose four percent to 28.7 billion crowns.
AEG Hausgeraete was acquired by Electrolux in 1994.
